Source ticket: MAG-35 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-35/poll-attemps-tracking
Project: architecture   Priority: High

Tier 1 of RM36-poll-run-tracking. Add the poll_runs table (one row per run_id) owned by internal/telemetry, the telemetry.RunWriter port internal/app will call, the Tesla Fleet API call counting (a decorator around tesla.VehicleService, internal to telemetry — internal/tesla is NOT modified), the new CycleReport fields, and the disambiguated LogCycle line. Tier 2 (internal/app measures the run and calls the port) is a separate change.

decisions.decision: Design gate PASSED as designed: poll_runs with run_id as PRIMARY KEY, no FK to poll_attempts, NOT NULL finished_at/duration_seconds, and no index beyond the PK's automatic B-tree.
decisions.why: run_id is already a unique per-invocation identity; write order forbids a FK in both directions; RecordRun is a single INSERT after the run is measured; the table has no reader and gains ~1-3 rows/day.

decisions.decision: Leader fixed the spec.md ordering itself (moved the SHALL paragraph above the **Reason** block) instead of re-dispatching the rate-limited worker.
decisions.why: A one-paragraph reordering with no semantic change. Re-dispatching a worker to move two paragraphs costs a full doc-pack re-read for nothing.

decisions.decision: Batched tasks.md's 6 declared waves into 3 serial worker dispatches (A: 1.1-3.2, B: 4.1-4.2, C: 5.x+6.x) along the real dependency cuts.
decisions.why: All 15 tasks share one module and one worker identity. Six dispatches would re-read the full doc pack six times. Every depends_on is still honoured inside each batch.

decisions.decision: Appended task 4.3 (change LogCycle's printed line) to tasks.md and to this file. No original task edited report.go.
decisions.why: design.md D8 and spec.md's MODIFIED 'Nightly Cycle Log Summary' both require it, and task 5.2 asserts the new labels — so 5.2 would have failed against unchanged code. Append-only respected.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's deviation from design.md's runIDToPgUUID note, and corrected that note in design.md.
decisions.why: poll_runs.run_id is NOT NULL (D3), so sqlc generates uuid.UUID; the helper exists for poll_attempts' nullable pgtype.UUID. Leader verified both generated types. Gated DDL unaffected.
